LABEL: W1_GROUND_TRUTH_TABLE
charter: One row per game, all 804. THE single source Window 1 is read from - charts, reviews, exams, the library. No number about W1 exists outside it. Rows only - no aggregates. UNKNOWN is an answer; inference is labeled; nothing is guessed.

column_sources.formation_end_*|open_postformation_*: fit-local/ticks/<ticker>.csv.gz via SPREAD_SETTLE rule @ 3c7bc577: first mid with spread<=10c holding <=20c for 30 min
column_sources.bell_machine_epoch: MARKET_EVENT_LEDGER_804 t_minus_actual_bell observation fields @ 4716657a (exact, zero within-game spread)
column_sources.bell_observed_inplay_epoch: replay-live-v4/observed_starts.db first_inplay_at (UTC; in-play DISCOVERY moment - upper bound, lags the bell)
column_sources.bell_tape_signature_epoch: TAPE_SIGNATURE @ 3c7bc577: earliest sustained mirrored repricing; validated on 192 machine-known bells (median +1 min, 89% within +-30 min)
column_sources.kalshi_close_time_epoch: Kalshi API GET /trade-api/v2/markets/<ticker> close_time (winner declared - upper bound), fetched 2026-08-14; cached in W1_GROUND_TRUTH_SOURCES/kalshi_lifecycle_1608.json
column_sources.bell_epoch|bell_source|bell_precision: best evidence by rank MACHINE_RECEIPT > TAPE_INFERENCE_CORROBORATED > OBSERVED_STARTS_UPPER_BOUND > TAPE_INFERENCE > UNKNOWN; SETTLEMENT_NO_MATCH for DJECIN per 3f4b0046. UNKNOWN is an answer; nothing is guessed
column_sources.span_start_epoch|span_end_epoch|verified: span = [formation_end_game, min(bell, w1_right)]; EMPTY when the bell precedes formation; UNKNOWN when the bell is unknown
column_sources.leg_*_floor|close|contracts|premium: fit-local/prints.jsonl true prints inside the verified span only (tape verified vs exchange by trade_id @ db470ec8 / 3f4b0046); premium_usd = sum(size*price)/100
column_sources.leg_*_journey|net_travel_c: net = span close - post-formation open; STILL if |net|<5c else MOVER (threshold per ec88f8e3)
column_sources.us_*_fill_c|fill_epoch: MARKET_EVENT_LEDGER_804 legs entry_cents/fill_timestamp_epoch @ 4716657a (the dev-804 V52e machine)
column_sources.us_*_fill_stamp: fill vs bell_epoch: PRE_BELL_VALID / POST_BELL_INVALID / UNKNOWN_BELL (fills at/below an OBSERVED_STARTS upper bound stamp UNKNOWN_BELL - never guessed; SETTLEMENT_NO_MATCH games stamp PRE_BELL_VALID, no bell ever rang)
column_sources.locked_delta_valid_fills_c: 100 - sum(entries) only when BOTH legs are PRE_BELL_VALID and sum<100; else null
